keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms to look up, for example igcse, sat prep, ib maths tutor.

geos.title: Countries
geos.description: Two-letter country codes such as AE, SA, QA, GB, US. Leave the list empty or use an empty entry for worldwide.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: today 12-m (12 months), today 3-m, today 5-y, now 7-d, all, or two dates like 2025-01-01 2025-12-31.

compareTogether.title: Compare keywords with each other
compareTogether.description: Off: each keyword gets its own 0-100 scale. On: up to 5 keywords share one scale, so their numbers can be compared.

category.title: Category id
category.description: Google Trends category id; 0 means all categories. Other ids are listed on the Trends page.

includeTimeline.title: Add one row per time point
includeTimeline.description: Adds the full weekly or daily series (recordType timeline), handy for charts.

includeRelatedQueries.title: Add related queries
includeRelatedQueries.description: Adds the top and rising related searches for each keyword (recordType relatedQuery).

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Language code used for the request, for example en-US.

delayBetweenRequestsMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
delayBetweenRequestsMs.description: Google Trends limits how fast it can be asked; 2500 ms is a gentle default. A rate-limit answer is waited out.
